scope: Read-only static review of unexecuted cache evidence inventory. No acceptance, copy, packaging, VM or source mutation performed by reviewer.
checks: Successful full acceptance/revision/seed and ten typed input references are mandatory before inventory
Six successful gate rows and six unique actually logged EL2 fixture paths are required
Current and historical evidence groups retain separate labels and recorded source revisions
Binary/state/payload/compiler target inputs and private bridge/config filenames are excluded; large raw references retained
Original bytes are only read; before/after identity check brackets each included read
Output is a new cache artifact outside the frozen source worktree
limitations: Eventual accepted binder and exact included/excluded inventory are not available yet and must be checked after actual execution
Reference identities preserve original receipts; this static review does not requalify their historical results
